due_when.clears_when: A CI guard fails when a file under src/ reads an env var (os.environ.get / os.getenv) that is absent from get_env.py's ALLOWED_KEYS, with a declared exemption list for vars genuinely not worth a read surface (each exemption carrying a one-line reason, verified-not-presence-only in the style of collapsed-state-guard). The guard must ship with a self-test proving it FAILS on a planted unlisted var, and must state its denominator (vars scanned / listed / exempted) so a clean run is a measured clean rather than an empty scan.
